title: epic: record page v2 — one default open mode per object (drawer by default, page by declaration; modal / split / popover retired as metadata); the drawer and the page are one page at two widths; related records open in place
body:
Epic parent (pm-dispatch 〈Epic 子树车道〉): this card and its children are reserved for the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`; they carry `pm:epic` and never `pm:queue`, so no domain seat takes them. The spec child is claimed from this session on the maintainer's direct instruction (footer), which is the authority that overrides the "spec sub-issues go to the spec seat's queue" default.

## Territory (files this subtree edits; other lanes avoid them while the children are open)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (`NavigationModeSchema`, `NavigationConfigSchema`), `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (`recordAction`), `packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts` (the `recordAction` options), plus the spec retirement kit files the `spec-property-retirement` skill names.
- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts`; `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/**` (`deriveRecordSurface`), `ui/packages/plugin-calendar`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-gantt` navigation reads.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `DetailTabs.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` — only after #26637 (in flight, domain:ui seat 4) lands.

## Children (dispatch order; file surfaces that overlap run in series)

1. #26677 — spec + its console consumers: `navigation.mode` keeps `page | drawer | new_window | none`, `modal` / `split` / `popover` retired; the default is `drawer` in the schema and in the console (the field-count guess goes); list-page `recordAction` drops `modal`; the console's split pane stays as a per-user preference read, not metadata.
2. #26678 — the record page is one page at two widths: three resident columns at 1280 px and up, two columns with a collapsible related rail from 1024 px, the tabs it has today below that and in the drawer. (parallel with 1: disjoint files)
3. #26679 — drawer v2 navigation: the bar is ↑ ↓ · ⤢ · ✕; a related row or a lookup opens its record in place with a trail; ← / Esc go back one level; ⤢ carries the trail into the page; on the record page a related row opens a drawer over the page. (after 1)
4. #26681 — the list Display menu gains 「打开记录」 (drawer | split) as a per-user preference; an object declaring `page` shows the declaration instead; the name cell's hover ↗ opens the record as a full page. (after 1 and #26637)

Not in this subtree, on purpose: the clickable stage path (#26612 / #26581 are in flight on that surface), inline field editing and the merged timeline (the record page already has an activity timeline and comments; nothing measured broken there). HotCRM needs no card: its views declare only `page` (lead) and `drawer` (opportunity, task, case), none of the retired modes (`git grep "navigation: {"` on HotCRM `1f3f8880`).

## Rulings (maintainer, 2026-10-27, chat in the filing session — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. The model, quoted back by the maintainer and ordered built: 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the drawer's top bar: 「左上角的 任务 · 2 / 2 · 分屏 几个字有必要嘛」 — no object name, no mode label on the bar.
3. On the position counter: 「我觉得记录详情页显示第几条记录 好像也没必要」 — no "n / N" anywhere on a record; the ↑ ↓ previous / next controls stay.
4. On the right pane: 「右侧应该可以拖动吗？展开为整页那个是不是用图标就可以」 — the pane is drag-resizable and "open as full page" is an icon-only control with a tooltip.
5. On related records, the maintainer confirmed the in-place model: 「所以关联记录是一层一层的往下点，然后可以一层一层的反悔吗」 — one level down per click, one level back per ← / Esc, never a second drawer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-27, from the record-page / list-page assessment and the clickable prototype the maintainer walked and ruled on in that session (objectstack main `416a76030e`, HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0). The maintainer's instruction to build it, verbatim: 「你直接立卡派发处理这个开发，然后审核。」 Design evidence (never merged): branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` at commit `345ec777220843ce1fd7f95b6cc0b2b6dcc81bf8`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/` (`prototype.html`, `artboards/`, `assessment.md`).</sub>
